name: Concordia Cooperative Intelligence Challenge
description: Develop autonomous language model agents capable of effective cooperation in mixed-motive, text-mediated environments, balancing individual goals with collective welfare.

cr:input.name: competition_dataset
cr:input.description: Participants receive natural language descriptions from the GM, including updates to grounded variables and event consequences, as well as injected memories providing scenario-specific contextual details.

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Participants must produce text-based descriptions of agent actions, decisions, or strategies in free-form natural language, constrained by LM token limits per round.

field.name: id
field.description: unique identifier for the scenario, e.g., scenario_001

field.name: pred
field.description: text-based description of agent actions, decisions, or strategies

cr:evaluation.primaryMetric: Quantitative scores measuring individual returns and social welfare
metrics: Quantitative scores measuring individual returns and social welfare
Social welfare scores using different welfare functions
Qualitative analysis of transcripts for cooperative behaviors
cr:evaluation.notes: LM-based reward models assign scores based on GM-determined outcomes. Final scores are averaged across environments, co-player populations, and replications.

open_questions: What are the exact details of the baseline strategies provided in the starter kit?
What specific LM is used for the competition, and what are the token limits per round?
How are qualitative metrics like reciprocity or resource sharing quantified?
fill_in_the_blank: Exact implementation details of baseline strategies
